prompt.zh-TW: 藍鯨水族這一期的本期淨利是 {{money:vars.profit}}，月底卻付不出 {{money:vars.bill}} 的飼料貨款。最可能的原因是什麼？
prompt.en: Blue Whale Aquatics made a profit of {{money:vars.profit}} this period, yet at month end it cannot pay a {{money:vars.bill}} fish-food bill. What is the most likely reason?

text.zh-TW: 大多是賒銷，利益算進去了，錢還在應收帳款上
text.en: Mostly credit sales: the profit is counted but the money is still in receivables

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。有賺到，不等於有收到。
feedback.en: Nice work. Earned is not the same as received.

short.zh-TW: 賒銷的錢還在應收帳款上
short.en: The money is still in receivables

text.zh-TW: 利益一定算錯了，有賺錢的公司不可能付不出錢
text.en: The profit must be wrong; a profitable company cannot fail to pay a bill

feedback.zh-TW: 直覺上有賺錢就該有錢，這個想法很常見。不過利益是依權責發生制算的：賣出去就算收入，不管錢收到沒有。利益可以是對的，現金卻還在路上。
feedback.en: It feels natural that profit should mean cash, and the thought is common. But profit follows the accrual basis: a sale counts as revenue whether or not the cash has arrived. The profit can be right while the cash is still on its way.

text.zh-TW: 本期淨利要等到年底結帳才會變成帳戶裡的現金
text.en: Profit for the period only turns into cash in the account when the books are closed at year end

feedback.zh-TW: 你知道利益和現金不是同一個數字，這點沒錯。不過結帳不會變出現金；錢什麼時候進來，看的是客人什麼時候付款，和結帳日無關。
feedback.en: You know profit and cash are not the same figure, which is right. But closing the books does not conjure up cash; when the money arrives depends on when customers pay, not on the closing date.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_05t9wphy}}下，收入在賣出時認列，不是在收錢時。賒銷越多，{{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}}和現金的距離就越大，所以答案是{{option:o_deft}}。{{option:o_we2b}}把利益和現金畫上等號，{{option:o_vn4y}}則以為結帳會把利益變成現金。
explanation.en: Under the {{term:tm_05t9wphy}}, revenue is recognised when the sale is made, not when the cash arrives. The more sales are on credit, the wider the gap between {{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}} and cash, so the answer is {{option:o_deft}}. {{option:o_we2b}} equates profit with cash, and {{option:o_vn4y}} imagines that closing the books turns profit into cash.
